confidentialite.description: How EduPlateforme handles personal data: on this website, and in its products for schools.
confidentialite.resume: In short: this website collects nothing and sets no cookies. Our products process data about students, who are minors; the school is responsible for it, and EduPlateforme processes it on the school’s behalf — never selling it or using it for any other purpose.

paragraphes: For this website: EduPlateforme, digital studio in Nouakchott — 25038@supnum.mr.

For a school’s data (students, families, staff): the school itself is the data controller. EduPlateforme provides the products and processes that data on the school’s behalf, following its instructions.
This processing falls under Mauritanian Law No. 2017-020 of 22 July 2017 on the protection of personal data.
This website sets no cookies, uses no audience-measurement tool and loads no third-party content: the typefaces are hosted on the site itself.
The contact form sends nothing to this website. It prepares your message and opens it in WhatsApp or your email app; you send it yourself. Messages we receive are used only to reply to you.
Like any web server, the one hosting this website may keep technical logs (IP address, requested page, date), used for its security and kept for ⟦to be completed: log retention period⟧.
Everything below is entered by the school for enrolment and school life, or produced by normal use of the products. Nothing else is collected.
liste: The student: surname, first name, sex, date and place of birth, NNI and RIM numbers if provided, class and school year.
Their schooling: grades, averages, report cards, rank, absences and late arrivals, teachers’ remarks, homework and attachments, timetable, signed documents.
Payments: fees due, recorded payments, receipt numbers, discounts and exemptions.
The parent or guardian: name, phone numbers, chosen language; the password is stored only as an Argon2id hash, which no one can read.
Staff: identity, role, salary and payroll items.
Technical data: the device’s notification token, IP address and device type at sign-in, the activity log.

paragraphes: Students are minors. They have no account and never sign in. Their data is processed by the school as part of its teaching mission, and is visible only to authorised staff, according to their role, and to the parent or guardian the school has registered as the student’s contact.
When a grade is entered, the notification says a grade is available; the figure never shows on the phone’s lock screen.
No data is sold or passed to advertisers, brokers or social networks. No advertising, no profiling. A school’s data serves that school only.

liste: The school’s staff, each according to their role; every access is checked by the server.
The host of our products, which stores the data without accessing it: ⟦to be completed: name of the products’ host⟧.
Google (Firebase Cloud Messaging), only to deliver notifications: it receives the device token and the notification text.
suite: Each school is isolated from the others at database level: no query can, even by mistake, read another school’s data.

liste: Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes.
Repeated sign-in attempts are blocked, per account and per address.
A session is bound to the device that opened it; changing the password closes every session.
Actions are logged: who did what, and when.
suite: No system is infallible. In the event of a data breach likely to harm the people concerned, the school and EduPlateforme will inform them as soon as possible.

liste: A parent’s account: as long as they are the contact of an enrolled student, and until it is deleted.
School and financial data: during schooling, then for the retention period the law imposes on the school for its registers and accounting records.
Sessions: 90 days at most. Sign-in attempts: 30 days, then automatically deleted.
suite: The details specific to each school are in the privacy policy of its own space, readable without an account.

paragraphes: You can view your data and your children’s, ask for inaccurate information to be corrected, delete your parent account from the app, withdraw your consent to notifications and object to processing.

For a school’s data, contact its office first. For this website, or if you cannot reach the school, write to 25038@supnum.mr. You may also refer the matter to the personal data protection authority established by Law No. 2017-020.
This policy may change; the date at the top of the page will then change too.
